plan.name: Collect authenticated local Go acceptance evidence
plan.summary: Complete issue #567 in one plumbing change: validate the existing Go producer's authenticated runtime lifecycles and expose their conversion to RepositoryAcceptanceEvidence through the local process environment's optional RunAcceptance, with fresh invocation authority, the full test identity, discovered package, verbatim source digest and captured execution digest pinned throughout. Require exactly one selection and an authentic start and terminal for the exact selected test, validate actual parent/child and parallel lifecycles without mistaking interleaving for reordering, preserve explanations and partial evidence, and refuse duplicate, stale, contradictory, truncated or mismatched observations; real passes, assertions, panics and selected skips become test outcomes, while absent or unfinished execution, discovery, helper and compiler failures never qualify and infrastructure errors veto qualification. Reuse Select before preparation and successful Discover before runtime, preserve every supported captured flag and ordinary Go semantics, run pinned sources offline using the resolved toolchain and standard library with isolated storage, and inherit the remaining allowance through bounded process-tree cleanup. Add separate default real-runtime acceptance fixtures and preserve every existing acceptance_*, go_*, native_* and process-transport test and fake unchanged, including the trusted #515 evidence contract and Run/ReadFile/Close-only environments; shared orchestration, Docker transport and compiler attribution remain the already planned subsequent steps, with no default adapters, configured planning admission, external intake or legacy Go changes. Update SPEC.md with decision-cited current-state bullets, docs/factory.md with the local collector API and qualification rules, and the README's brief linked description; the merger records this refinement of D-0327 and D-0321 on the existing D-0316 foundation, and unavailable Docker/network checks belong to Merger work while affected real Python and TLAPS suites remain CI requirements.

tests.name: TestLocalGoRuntimeEvidence
tests.says: Local RunAcceptance executes identical pinned bytes against real base and changed production, binds fresh discovered identities, and reports actual pass, assertion, panic, skip and unfinished execution without treating absence or exit as completion.

tests.name: TestLocalGoRuntimeExactSelectors
tests.says: Only the exact discovered runtime test qualifies, including nested, parallel, slash-containing and parameter case names, external tests and duplicate names in other parts and packages; ancestors, prefixes, siblings and absent cases cannot substitute.

tests.name: TestGoRuntimeCollectorRejectsCorruption
tests.says: The collector accepts real controls and legal parallel interleaving, rejects damaged real streams and every changed binding, and retains authentic partial evidence while transport errors veto qualification.

tests.name: TestLocalGoRuntimeIgnoresDiagnostics
tests.says: Forged lifecycle frames, textual and JSON results and fresh bindings printed by real initialization, TestMain and tests on both streams cannot change acceptance outcomes or complete an unfinished test.

tests.name: TestLocalGoRuntimeAdmissionAndPolicy
tests.says: Selection refuses unsupported commands before preparation, failed real discovery or helper preparation prevents runtime, local RunAcceptance rejects changed authority, and supported captured flags, verbatim sources and offline isolated execution remain effective.

tests.name: TestLocalGoRuntimeCancellationAndCleanup
tests.says: Real discovery, helper compilation and running tests inherit the caller's remaining deadline; cancellation is bounded, authentic partial evidence and diagnostics survive, all owned processes disappear and idempotent bounded cleanup releases private storage.
